safety_notes: Warm up before each strength session
Stay hydrated before, during, and after workouts
Distinguish good muscle fatigue from harmful pain
Allow 48hr recovery between intense sessions for same muscle group

exercises.name: Dynamic Warm-up Circuit
exercises.description: Activate muscles and increase blood flow before strength training
steps: Arm circles: 10 forward, 10 backward
Cat-cow: 10 reps
Inchworms: 6 reps
Shoulder taps in plank: 20 total
Bodyweight squats: 12 reps
Jumping jacks: 30 sec
tips: Spend extra time on tight areas
exercises.easier: Reduce reps 30%, substitute marching for jumping jacks
exercises.harder: Add 5 burpees, extend jumping jacks to 60 sec

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.description: Compound upper body exercise targeting chest, shoulders, and triceps
steps: Plank position, hands slightly wider than shoulders
Engage core, elbows at 45° to body
Lower until chest is 2-3 inches from floor
Push through palms to start; exhale on push, inhale on lower
exercises.harder: 2-sec pause at bottom, or elevate feet

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rows (Single Arm)
exercises.description: Build back strength and improve posture
steps: Knee and hand on bench, opposite foot on floor
Hold dumbbell, arm hanging straight
Pull dumbbell to hip, driving elbow back
Squeeze shoulder blade at top, lower with control
Complete all reps, switch sides
exercises.easier: Lighter weight (5-8 kg) or bilateral bent-over rows
exercises.harder: +2 kg, 1-sec pause at top, or increase to 12 reps

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Press
steps: Sit with back supported, feet flat, dumbbells at shoulder height
Press up until arms extended, dumbbells nearly touching
Lower with control to shoulder height
Keep back against bench throughout
tips: Stop just short of locking elbows
exercises.harder: +2 kg or standing press for core challenge

exercises.name: Plank Hold with Variations
exercises.description: Core stability essential for running efficiency and injury prevention
steps: Forearm plank: elbows under shoulders, body straight
Hold 30 sec, rest 15 sec
Right arm extended forward 15 sec, rest 15 sec
Left arm extended forward 15 sec, repeat sequence
exercises.easier: Knee plank or reduce to 15-20 sec holds
exercises.harder: Hold 45-60 sec or add shoulder taps
warnings: Drop to knees if hips sag

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.description: Strengthen obliques and improve rotational core stability
steps: Sit with knees bent, lean back 45°, hold weight at chest
Lift feet 2-3 inches (optional)
Rotate torso side to side, tapping weight near each hip
exercises.easier: Feet on ground, lighter or no weight
exercises.harder: Extend legs, use 10 kg, increase to 30 reps

exercises.name: Cool-down: Upper Body & Core Stretches
exercises.description: Prevent tightness and promote recovery after strength work
steps: Doorway chest stretch: 30 sec each side
Overhead tricep stretch: 30 sec each arm
Seated spinal twist: 30 sec each side
Cat-cow: 10 slow reps
Child's pose: 60 sec
Deep breathing: 10 breaths (4-count in, 6-count out)
tips: Gentle pull only - no sharp pain
warnings: Stop any stretch causing sharp pain

exercises.name: Easy Conversational Pace Run
exercises.description: Build aerobic base for half marathon training
steps: 5-min warm-up walk, gradually increasing pace
30 min at conversational pace (65-75% max HR)
Focus on form: midfoot strike, relaxed shoulders
Walk breaks (1 min every 10 min) if needed
5-min cool-down walk
tips: Should feel EASY - patience builds base
exercises.easier: 5 min run/1 min walk intervals, or reduce to 20 min

exercises.name: Post-Run Dynamic Stretching
exercises.description: Maintain flexibility and prevent tightness after running
steps: Walking lunges with twist: 10 per leg
Leg swings: 10 forward/back and 10 side-to-side per leg
Standing quad stretch: 30 sec per leg
Calf stretch: 30 sec per leg
Hip flexor lunge stretch: 30 sec per side
Pigeon or figure-4: 30 sec per side
tips: Focus on hip flexors and calves
warnings: Care with hamstrings if prone to pulls

exercises.name: Dynamic Lower Body Warm-up
exercises.description: Activate glutes, hips, and legs before heavy strength work
steps: Glute bridges: 15 reps
Bodyweight squats: 15 reps
Lateral band walks: 10 steps each direction
High knees: 30 sec
Butt kicks: 30 sec
World's greatest stretch: 5 reps per side
tips: Feel glutes activating - they're your power generators
exercises.easier: Reduce reps 50%, skip high knees/butt kicks
exercises.harder: Add resistance band, extend to 10 min
warnings: Stop if knee or hip pain

exercises.name: Goblet Squats
exercises.description: Fundamental lower body strength targeting quads, glutes, and core
steps: Hold dumbbell at chest, feet slightly wider than shoulders, toes out
Lower until thighs parallel, keeping weight at chest and chest up
Drive through full foot to stand, squeeze glutes at top
Keep knees tracking over toes throughout
exercises.easier: Lighter weight, half depth, or box squats
exercises.harder: +2-4 kg, 2-sec pause at bottom, or 15 reps
warnings: Joint pain = stop; muscle burn is OK
Don't let knees cave or heels lift

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlifts (RDLs)
exercises.description: Posterior chain targeting hamstrings, glutes, and lower back
steps: Stand with dumbbells at thighs, soft knees, core engaged
Hinge at hips, pushing them back, lowering weights down legs
Lower to mid-shin, maintaining flat back
Drive hips forward to stand, squeeze glutes
exercises.easier: Lighter weight, stop at knees, or BW single-leg RDL
exercises.harder: +2-4 kg, 2-sec pause at bottom, or single-leg with dumbbells
warnings: Lower back pain = stop; only hamstring stretch is correct

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squats
exercises.description: Unilateral leg strength to correct imbalances and build single-leg power
steps: Stand 2-3 ft from bench, rear foot elevated (shoelaces down)
Lower straight down until front thigh is parallel, torso upright
Drive through front heel to stand
Complete all reps, switch legs
exercises.easier: Bodyweight, reduced depth, or hold wall for balance
exercises.harder: +2 kg per hand, 2-sec pause at bottom
warnings: Front knee pain = adjust stance distance

exercises.name: Calf Raises (Standing)
exercises.description: Strengthen calves for push-off power and injury prevention
steps: Balls of feet on step edge, heels hanging
Lower heels below step (2 sec), rise onto toes as high as possible (2 sec)
Hold at top 1 sec, lower with control
Final set: 10 reps per leg single-leg
exercises.harder: Hold dumbbell, or full set single-leg

exercises.name: Lower Body & Hip Stretches
exercises.description: Post-strength stretching for recovery and flexibility
steps: Standing quad stretch: 30 sec per leg
Standing hamstring stretch: 30 sec per leg
Pigeon pose: 45 sec per side
Low lunge hip flexor: 30 sec per side
Seated butterfly: 45 sec
Supine figure-4: 30 sec per side
Lying hamstring stretch: 30 sec per leg
tips: Exhale to sink deeper into stretches
exercises.easier: 20 sec holds, skip pigeon if uncomfortable

exercises.name: Vinyasa Flow with Core Emphasis
exercises.description: Power yoga focusing on core strength, flexibility, and mind-body connection
steps: Sun Salutation A: 5 rounds
Sun Salutation B: 5 rounds with warrior poses
Core sequence: Boat pose 30 sec, plank transitions x10, side plank 30 sec each
Balance series: Tree, Warrior III, Half Moon - 45 sec each side
Hip opening: Lizard, pigeon, frog - 60 sec each side
Cool-down: Forward fold, supine twists, savasana 5 min
exercises.easier: Skip Warrior III/Half Moon, reduce hold times
exercises.harder: Hold 60 sec, add crow pose, or extend to 90 min
warnings: Modify Warrior III if balance is poor

exercises.name: Tempo Run
exercises.description: Threshold training to improve lactate clearance and race pace
steps: 10 min easy warm-up jog
4x100m strides at 85% effort, walk back recovery
20 min at comfortably hard pace (80-85% max HR)
Can speak short phrases, not full sentences
10 min easy cool-down jog to walk
tips: Even pacing is critical - don't start too fast
Should finish worked but not destroyed
exercises.easier: Reduce tempo to 15 min or 75-80% max HR
exercises.harder: Extend to 25-30 min or add hills
warnings: Stop if chest pain or extreme breathlessness

exercises.name: Core Finisher Circuit
exercises.description: High-intensity core circuit when fatigued - mimics race conditions
steps: Plank: 45 sec
Bicycle crunches: 30 total
Dead bugs: 20 total
Side plank: 30 sec each side
Mountain climbers: 30 sec max effort
Rest 60 sec, repeat x3 total
tips: Doing this tired trains race-specific endurance
warnings: Skip if exhausted from tempo run

exercises.name: Full Body Recovery Stretching
exercises.description: Comprehensive post-workout stretching for running muscles
steps: Downward dog: 60 sec
Low lunge with quad stretch: 45 sec per side
Pigeon pose: 60 sec per side
Seated forward fold: 60 sec
Supine spinal twist: 45 sec per side
Happy baby: 60 sec
Legs up wall: 3-5 min
Savasana: 5 min
tips: Legs up wall aids circulation - it works
exercises.easier: 30 sec holds, skip legs up wall
exercises.harder: 90 sec holds, add yin yoga poses
